name: AI usage
description: Shows your Claude Code and Codex limits in one widget, with reset countdowns and weekly pace, using the sign-ins those tools already keep.
author: Seb-GRAF

claude.title: Claude
claude.description: The limits the bar shows. The popup shows them all; Off hides Claude.

claudeAccounts.title: More Claude accounts
claudeAccounts.description: Claude Code folders signed in to other accounts, separated by commas, such as Work=~/.claude-work. A name is optional and shows on the bar. Write each folder as CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR has it; ~/.claude is Claude Code's default sign-in.

codex.title: Codex
codex.description: The limits the bar shows. The popup shows them all; Off hides Codex.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: Stacked puts the week under the session. One line labels them 5h and W.
